clue.text: Sign to return here?

parts.note: a musical score marking telling the player to go back to the opening bars and play from the beginning

explanation.surface: A notice pointing a traveller back to the spot they started from.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian direction means 'from the head', instructing the performer to repeat from the start of the piece.

clue.text: A diploma one frames

parts.note: BAC is short for baccalaureate, a school-leaving diploma
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A certificate that someone has had framed for the wall.
explanation.definitionFit: Counting frames with beads on wires are abacuses; the classical plural is this word.

clue.text: Becoming aware of long broadcast in shade

indicators.note: the sounded word sits inside the word for shade

parts.note: an awning is a canopy giving shade

indicators.note: broadcast signals that the word for long is heard, not spelt

parts.note: to long is to ache for something

explanation.surface: Someone yearning while sitting under a canopy as something plays on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns ACHE into its sound AKE, which goes 'in' AWNING.
explanation.definitionFit: An awakening is the dawning realisation of something, the act of coming to know it.

clue.text: Ordinary at Easter in Notre Dame is not unclear

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for ordinary, as in O level
the French for Easter is Pâques, and Notre Dame points to Paris and French

explanation.surface: An ordinary Easter service at the Paris cathedral is perfectly clear.
explanation.walkthrough: The French word for Easter is properly plural, Pâques; the clue takes it without its S.
explanation.definitionFit: Opaque writing or reasoning is hard to understand, obscure rather than transparent.

clue.text: Suits one giving way to guesswork and doubts

indicators.note: one thing giving way to another means it is replaced by it

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one
spec, as in buying on spec, is speculation or guesswork

explanation.surface: Business suits leaving everything to guesswork and doubt.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing the I of SUITS and putting SPEC where it was gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspect something is to have doubts or mistrust about it; both are verbs here.

clue.text: Shopfitter heeds wild animal

indicators.note: wild letters run out of control, so these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shop-fitting tradesman pays attention to a wild beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The camel is nicknamed this, as the beast that carries loads across arid sand like a vessel at sea.

clue.text: More drowsy fish return to jetty

indicators.note: return asks for the fish word to be read backwards

parts.note: eels are fish
a pier is a jetty projecting into water

explanation.surface: Fish heading back to the jetty seem increasingly drowsy.
explanation.definitionFit: A comparative adjective: sleepy means drowsy, so the comparative is more drowsy.

clue.text: Cheer earl that's out of office

parts.note: late means former, as in the late chairman no longer in post

explanation.surface: Raising the spirits of a nobleman who has lost his post.
explanation.definitionFit: To cheer someone is to make them happy and in high spirits; both are verbs.

clue.text: Bewildered perv I date in transport

indicators.note: bewildered means confused, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A confused pervert on a date while on public transport.
explanation.definitionFit: In computing, a tape transport is the mechanism that moves magnetic tape past the heads, the same device.

clue.text: Courteous woman is clothing accountant with, initially, evening coat

indicators.note: clothing means wrapping around, so the accountant goes inside

parts.note: madam is the polite form of address to a woman
CA is a chartered accountant

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A polite lady dresses an accountant in an evening coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evening coat' looks like a garment, but 'coat' alone is the verb definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To surface a road with crushed stone, named after the engineer John McAdam, is to coat it.

clue.text: Lots of current tent sites not opened

indicators.note: unopened means missing its first letter

parts.note: camps are places where tents are pitched

explanation.surface: Campsites closed despite lots of tents being available.
explanation.definitionFit: Amperes measure electric current; a large current is many of these units.

clue.text: Ceremony with character adds to a sudden slowdown

parts.note: a rite is a ceremony
nu is a Greek letter, a character of that alphabet

explanation.surface: A ritual whose character brings things to an abrupt halt.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning held back: the tempo is reduced immediately rather than gradually.

clue.text: Sham's manufacturing us dope

definitions.note: Sham's stands for sham is, so the definition is just sham

indicators.note: manufacturing means making something new from the letters

explanation.surface: A fake operation producing drugs for us.
explanation.definitionFit: Something false or pretended, a sham, is described by this adjective or prefix.

clue.text: Drink from West African not Chinese

indicators.note: not means without, so the Chinese word is removed

parts.note: the Ashanti are a people of Ghana in West Africa
the Han are the majority ethnic group of China

explanation.surface: A drink served by someone from West Africa, not China.
explanation.definitionFit: A sparkling Italian wine from Piedmont, named after its town of origin.

clue.text: Southern donkey's failure for producer of suspended particles

parts.note: moke is British slang for a donkey
a bomb is a flop, a show that failed

explanation.surface: A Southern donkey's flop produces dust in the air.
explanation.definitionFit: This device releases a cloud, which is particles suspended in the air.

clue.text: Sir Herbert's knowing about music but essentially wooden

parts.note: Sir Herbert Beerbohm Tree was a Victorian actor-manager; the possessive adds an S
hip, from jazz slang, means in the know and aware of the latest sounds

explanation.surface: An actor-manager knows his music but is stiff on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: The state of being a tree is to be of timber by nature, a playful coinage.

clue.text: They were visited by night while seated

definitions.text: They were visited by night while seated

parts.words: They were visited by night while seated
parts.note: recalls the carol in which an angel appears to the flock-watchers all seated on the ground by night

explanation.surface: Guests who called after dark found their hosts sitting down.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Christmas story, an angel came to men tending their flocks at night.

clue.text: Farewell remark about amateur artist

parts.note: to say is to remark
on means about, concerning
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A parting comment about an amateur painter.
explanation.definitionFit: A Japanese word for goodbye, used in English as a farewell.

clue.text: Dismal expression of good fellow Bill in solitary confinement

indicators.note: the pieces are placed within the solitary word
confinement means being shut inside something

parts.note: lone means solitary
AC is short for account, a bill

explanation.surface: A good chap called Bill wears a gloomy look in solitary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a man's name but is the account.
explanation.definitionFit: A glum, miserable look is described by this idiom, the features drawn down in sadness.

clue.text: Watched by 16 we can be found keeping opponents apart

indicators.note: keeping means holding within, so one piece goes inside the other
apart means the two opponents are split by the word between them

parts.note: East and South are opposing partnerships at bridge

explanation.surface: We can be found separating rivals under the watchful eye of others.
explanation.definitionFit: Shepherds watch over female sheep, part of their flocks.

clue.text: The lowest points start to appear after a white note

indicators.note: after puts that letter behind the note

parts.note: a minim is a half note, printed as a hollow white note

indicators.note: start to takes the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Something begins to show up after a white note is played.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of the mathematical term for the least value of a function, the troughs.

clue.text: Straight from here to broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Direct from this place out onto the airwaves.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for heterosexual; 'straight' is the informal word for the same orientation.

clue.text: Flynn changed sides: that was a mistake

indicators.note: left is swapped for right, so the L becomes an R

parts.note: Errol Flynn was a Hollywood swashbuckling actor

explanation.surface: An actor defected to the other side and regretted it.
explanation.definitionFit: A noun meaning a blunder or slip, something done wrongly.

clue.text: Hot pipe to be returned before any manifestation

indicators.note: before puts the turned piece in front
returned means the hot letter and pipe are read backwards

parts.note: H abbreviates hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A hot pipe has to be sent back before anything else is done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be returned' turns H plus PIPE into EPIPH.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden revelation or appearance, especially of a deity, is a manifestation.

clue.text: In South Africa (and elsewhere) this day is celebrated (with greetings inclined to come from 27?)

definitions.text: In South Africa (and elsewhere) this day is celebrated (with greetings inclined to come from 27?)

parts.words: In South Africa (and elsewhere) this day is celebrated (with greetings inclined to come from 27?)
parts.note: a former South African province, and also the adjective for one's birth, as in a birthday celebrated with cards

explanation.surface: A national holiday celebrated in South Africa and beyond, with greetings arriving from afar.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means relating to birth, so one's birthday is this day; it is also a KwaZulu province name.

clue.text: Lady's got nothing for gardener

indicators.note: having got something inside means holding it

parts.note: her is the pronoun for a lady
O is the round zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A woman is left with nothing to pay her gardener.
explanation.definitionFit: One who weeds with a hoe is a gardener at work.

clue.text: 'Make better honey' I declaim after sample from apiary

indicators.note: after puts the rest behind that sampled letter
a sample is a small first taste of the word

parts.note: mel is Latin for honey, used in pharmacy
to orate is to declaim

explanation.surface: A beekeeper's grand proclamation about improving the honey.
explanation.definitionFit: To improve something or make it less bad is a synonym phrase for this verb.

clue.text: Wandering insect following president and bishop

indicators.note: following puts the insect after the other pieces

parts.note: Abe Lincoln, US president
RR is Right Reverend, a bishop's title
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: An insect tags along behind Lincoln and a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: Straying from the expected course; deviating, wandering from the norm.

clue.text: He had proof as answer to Wood

parts.note: elm is a wood

explanation.surface: A man with evidence replying to someone called Wood.
explanation.walkthrough: The archbishop is known for the ontological argument for God's existence.
explanation.definitionFit: The medieval Archbishop of Canterbury devised a famous philosophical demonstration of God's existence.
